title_en: Visions of the Future (6/20): Jules Verne's Fantastic Machines
note_en: 如此…以至于… means "so… that…" and links a high degree to its consequence: 给世界留下了如此深刻的印象，以至于后来有几艘真正的军用潜水艇都以它的名字命名 "made such a deep impression that several real submarines were named after it." 如此 is the formal written equivalent of 这么, and 以至于 introduces the result; the pair is typical of essay prose rather than speech.
